But the protocol's derivative formula is: G[k,p] = x[k,p] + rho*sum_{e in path}(L[e]/c[e]-B[e])/c[e] - 1. So the derivative term = rho*(L/c - B)/c = 2*(x/5+0.0925926)/5 = 0.08x + 0.037037 ✓.

So the objective term must be 0.5*rho*(L/c - B)² and its derivative rho*(L/c-B)*(1/c) ✓ = rho*(L/c-B)/c ✓. So f = 0.5x² + 0.5*rho*(x/5 + 0.0925926)² - x. Expanding: 0.5*2*(x/5 + 0.0926)² = (x/5+0.0926)². So f = 0.5x² + (0.2x + 0.0926)² - x → df/dx = x + 2*(0.2x+0.0926)*0.2 - 1 = x + 0.08x + 0.037037 - 1 ✓.
